name: Rimmel Provocalips 16hr Kissproof Lipstick, Little Minx, 0.14 Fluid Ounce
description: Up to 16 Hours of lip liberation. Wild without a trace. STEP 1: Apply colour and keep lips apart for 60 seconds until the product sets. STEP 2: Apply topcoat to lock the colour, moisture and add shine.
reviews:
I must say I am addicted to lip products, so I HAD to try these out. I got 2 colors to start off- Make your Move and Pucker Up.
Pucker up has tons of shimmer/glitter (which I'm not crazy about) and Make your Move is a lovely color.

Pros:
-The color stays on and doesn't budge! (No feathering, no lipstick on my teeth)
-In my experience, lasts about 8-10 hours
-No transfer, kiss proof, and mostly food proof (beware eating overly greasy foods)

Cons:
-Because the product is a stain, it tends to be really drying on the lips. I noticed that about 6 hours or so after applying it, my lips were so dry that they were starting to peel... AND I had already reapplied the clear topcoat twice.
-Color fades during the day, but is still visible for the most part.

Overall, I really like these and I will definitely be going back to buy some more colors! I will just need to be extra sure that my lips are exfoliated and moisturized so that I don't deal with overly dry lips by mid-day!
Lasts ALOT longer than 16 hrs! Looks fresh for that long too!

The biggest problem is the chemical smell... I am nauseated after 10 minutes. It is not very breathable after step 2. Plus it takes some skills to make the color even on the lips.... it still transfers some when i kissed a tissue. I think I will shy away from this kind of products now.

name: Rimmel Lasting Finish Lipstick Alarm
description: Long lasting Lipstick locks colour to lips for up to 8 hours wear. 50% more colour. Soft, smooth, comfortable formula.
reviews:
I picked this up as part of stage makeup for show choir because it was fairly cheap, not really caring what exact shade it was, but it turned out to be surprisingly good quality. It lasts quite a while, doesn't smell or taste bad, and is very pigmented.
I'd say this is a blue-toned red, but not to an extreme like MAC Russian Red, for example. So if that's not your thing, I don't recommend this. Also possibly not if you have very red blemishes either, since in my opinion, this makes them really stand out.
I like that you can dab it to make the color less intense or you can apply it the regular way to make your lips really stand out. Like most lipsticks, it won't look so hot if your lips are dry, but a little lip balm underneath should do the trick.

The lasting finish lipstick is my favorite of the rimmel products and my favorite shades are alarm, drop of sherry, and dizzy. it wears for a reasonable length of time, although you'll have to re-apply it at times, and it's very comfortable on your lips. this a lipstick i'll never stop buying, it's such an awesome lipstick.
My favorite lipstick.  Great color, not too red or orange and it stays, although not all day...
Great color! Goes on easily and comes off with makeup wipes with ease.
Color was much lighter than expected. Too much of an orange looking red.

description: Soft, velvety lipsticks glide on silky smooth for weightless wear. Moisturizes and conditions for rich colors that wont cake, feather, or bleed. Net Wt. 0.10oz / Poids net 2.95g
reviews:
I never wore black lipstick before, so I was a little nervous, but when it comes to lipstick colors I am quite darn daring if it looks good with my complexion.
You definitely want to make sure your lips are exfoliated with a little balm on them to keep them supple, but the lipstick is not hard to apply since it is pretty moist. I like to add a deep lip liner to give it a base and add some dimension. I noticed when I wear it the color kinda dried to a semi-matte look, which looks very nice. As far as it's long lasting wear when eating or drinking I am not really sure since I didn't eat much when wearing it.
I wore this for Halloween, but I could definitely see myself wearing it for a night out too! I am African American, so it wouldn't look too vampy on me. Also, I used my MAC lip liner in "night moth" with the lipstick and those colors together made it look like a dupe for MAC's Cyber lipstick!
Not matte or drying. Goes on smooth
One was broken

I've read some pretty positive reviews for this product and I am utterly confused. The formula on this particular color is absolutely awful. It goes on patchy and feels more like wax than creme. The color does not stay at all and requires constant touch-ups just to make it look even. It feathers like crazy which makes application a pain. The price in store is cheap but it isn't even worth it as it is essentially unusable. There are much better black lipsticks on the market and Wet n Wild has better formulas in other colors.

name: AYA Cosmetics Lipstick ~Naturally Nude~
description: AYA's moisturised mineral lipstick range is long-wearing, lip conditioning and naturally scented. reviews: I absolutely love the color of this lipstick.  It is a beautiful nude color, however it seems like it leaves some thick pieces on your lips as you apply.  My lips get a dark red whenever I eat, so I love that this lip color helps it stay neutral all day.  As with all lipsticks, it does leave lipstick on cups, etc. All in all, a beautiful nude color.

I just received this product a couple of days ago and I haven't worn the product all day yet, but I tried it on so I could see how the color was. The color is amazing!!!!!!!!! It's exactly like it looks in the picture! I have had a hard time finding a vegan nude lipstick. I purchased one from another brand  but it just masked the natural color of my lips a little; it wasn't thick and creamy like this one either. This lipstick is great and I will definitely continue to purchase it!

I was very impressed considering this lipstick contains 100% natural ingredients - the colour is exactly as it is in the photograph and it goes on nicely. I also like the smell. It looks great with gloss on top!

The color looks exactly like in the photo. I love that it's natural and comes in recycled packaging. I also like the fact that it arrived quickly with a hand-written thank-you note.

I don't usually wear lipstick, but the nude look really suits me. I tend to have dry lips, so I do have to apply a lot of lip balm underneath to keep my lips from looking cracked and messy, but I don't mind. Imperfections always show up a lot more with lighter colors like this, but as long as you take good care of your lips, it will look really cute.

It also looks really nice with a translucent gloss over it, if you want to add a little something to it.

I love it, especially for the price! Most cosmetics are so expensive... Would definitely recommend.
